response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State') AS state, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State')), total_accounts AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total FROM account_counts), state_shares AS (SELECT ac.state, ac.account_count, (ac.account_count * 100.0 / ta.total) AS share FROM account_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta WHERE ta.total > 0), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM state_shares) SELECT ss.state, ss.account_count AS combined_account_base, ss.share AS average_share, (ss.share - a.avg_share) AS above_average FROM state_shares ss CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY ss.state
